scripts.lint: biome check apps/api apps/web/src backend/src backend/local frontend/website/src packages tests scripts/*.ts services/lang-gateway
scripts.format: biome check --write apps/api apps/web/src backend/src backend/local frontend/website/src packages tests scripts/*.ts services/lang-gateway
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && esbuild apps/api/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/api.mjs
scripts.integration:build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config frontend/website/vite.config.ts
scripts.integration:dev: npm run integration:build && node --import tsx backend/local/server.ts
scripts.integration:worker:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply dhaaga-integration --local --config backend/wrangler.jsonc
